name: Portable Cabin
description:
Portable Cabin — Relocatable Structures for Any Use

A SAMAN portable cabin installed at a residential location. No foundation required — placed on a flat paved surface and ready to use on the same day.

You need a structure that goes up quickly, works for your specific use, and can move when your situation changes.

That's what a SAMAN portable cabin is built for. Factory-made MS frame, delivered across South India in 7-21 working days. Sizes from 8×10 ft upward. Starting at Rs 1,95,000.

Unlike a fixed building, a portable cabin isn't permanent — and that's the point. Retailers, homeowners, small businesses, institutions, and factory owners all use the same product in completely different ways. The cabin adapts to the use, not the other way around.

Built to be moved — and moved again

A SAMAN portable cabin is engineered from the base up to be lifted, transported and set down at a new site without losing its shape or finish. The welded mild-steel frame, corrugated MS skin and integrated lifting lugs let a crane pick the unit cleanly and a flatbed carry it to the next location. "Portable" here is not a figure of speech — the same cabin can serve one site, then travel to the next when your work moves.

Fast to place, fast to shift

Because the cabin is finished in our factory, placement is quick: you prepare a flat, level base, we deliver, offload and position, and the unit is usable the same day. When the time comes to relocate, the process reverses — disconnect services, lift, transport, re-level and reconnect. Planning the move around access and base preparation is what keeps a cabin reusable for years.

One cabin, many uses

The breadth of use is the point of this product. The same steel shell works as an office, a shop or counter, a store room, a study or spare room, an institutional space, or a supervisor's room — and it can be repurposed when your need changes. For a retail-first setup with a shopfront and counter, see our portable shop cabin. For a unit with an attached washroom at one end, see our portable cabin with toilet.

Made to your size — nine in-page sizes

Choose from nine standard footprints, from a compact 10×10 ft up to a 40×12 ft single unit, each priced above and configurable to your layout. Larger footprints stay on this one product — pick the size that matches both your space and how it will travel; longer 30–40 ft units ride a 40 ft open trailer, while 20 ft and under travel on a 20 ft trailer.

Structure and finish that survive relocation

Every cabin is built on a 100×50×3 mm MS C-channel base with a welded MS frame, a 1.2 mm corrugated MS exterior and a 1.4 mm corrugated MS roof, insulated with glass wool and finished inside with smooth 8 mm pre-laminated MDF walls and ceiling over a 1.3 mm vinyl floor on an 18 mm Bison panel. Powder-coated aluminium sliding windows and a 7×3 ft MS-framed door complete a unit made to be lifted, carried and reused — not a one-time build.

Planning a relocation — the practical checklist

This is where a portable cabin earns its keep, and it is the part most buyers are never told. Before first placement and before any later move: confirm a flat, compacted or paved base; confirm truck and crane access and a clear route to the spot; agree who handles offloading and positioning; and make sure power and any plumbing points can be safely disconnected and reconnected. After a move, re-level the unit, re-seal service entries, and check door and window operation. Choosing a size that stays within easy transport width keeps every future move simple.

Price — what the figure includes

Prices shown are ex-GST for the base specification of each size; 18% GST is added, and fit-out beyond the standard package and freight to your site are quoted separately. What moves your final number: size, insulation and panel choices, electrical and plumbing fit-out, finish level, and delivery distance from our Bangalore (South) or Greater Noida (North) unit. Send your size, use and location for an itemised quotation.

Delivery and installation across India

Every cabin is factory-built and delivered ready to use, dispatched from Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Our team offloads and positions the unit on your prepared base; most units are usable shortly after they land. When you relocate later, we can help arrange the transport.

How this differs from our site and office cabins

A portable cabin is built to be relocated and reused as your work moves. If your unit is going onto an active construction project as part of the site setup, our site cabins built for construction projects are configured for that duty. If you need a fully finished workspace to work in day to day rather than move between sites, our office-ready workspace cabins are set up for that. This page is the move-and-reuse cabin you lift, transport and re-site whenever the job changes.

Why buy from SAMAN

We manufacture in-house at our own Bangalore and Greater Noida units — you deal with the maker, not a reseller. SAMAN POS India Private Limited is ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified, NSIC-enlisted, DPIIT (Startup India) recognised, Udyam-registered and GST-registered, with 500+ projects delivered across India. Structural warranty is 5–10 years, confirmed at quotation.

Contacts: South — +91 88616 22859 / sales@samanportable.com · North — +91 87960 39938 / ncr@samanportable.com

Frequently Asked Questions

How is a portable cabin lifted, moved and placed at a new location?

A crane lifts the unit by its integrated MS lifting lugs onto a flatbed trailer; at the new site it is offloaded, positioned on a prepared level base and re-levelled. Services are disconnected before the move and reconnected after. Plan truck and crane access and a clear route at both ends.

What base do I need before placement, and again after relocation?

A flat, level, load-bearing surface — compacted ground, a concrete apron or a simple plinth. No deep foundation is required. Re-check level every time the unit is re-sited.

What access is needed for delivery and a later move?

Room for a delivery truck (20 ft or 40 ft trailer depending on cabin length) and, where used, a crane to lift the unit onto its base and off again. Confirm route width and overhead clearance for both placement and future relocation.

Can the same cabin be repurposed when my use changes?

Yes. The open steel shell can be re-fitted from, say, a site office to a store or shop; the structure is the same and the interior is reconfigured to your new use.

What must be disconnected and checked before and after a move?

Before: power supply and any water/waste points. After: re-level the unit, re-seal service entries, and check that the door and windows open and lock correctly.

How does size affect how easily a cabin can be relocated?

Longer 30–40 ft units travel on a 40 ft trailer and need more turning and crane room; 20 ft and under move on a 20 ft trailer. Choosing a footprint that stays within easy transport width keeps every future move simpler.
